terms.definition: A wire carrying a current in a magnetic field experiences a force.
terms.examiner: Higher tier: F = B I l, with B in tesla.

terms.definition: First finger: field; second finger: current; thumb: motion (force).
terms.examiner: Higher tier. The force is at right angles to both.

terms.definition: A coil carrying a current in a magnetic field experiences forces that make it rotate.
terms.examiner: Higher tier. A split-ring commutator reverses the current every half turn.

terms.definition: Uses the motor effect: a varying current in a coil in a magnetic field makes a cone vibrate, producing sound waves.
